original_target.title: Decidability of local asymptotic stability for polynomial ODEs

answer: Negative; no total Turing decider for local asymptotic stability.
required_status_qualification: Solved on the basis of an unverified announcement, arXiv:2610.12434v1 (8October2026). The full target is claimed; the external proof has not been independently verified here.
scope_comparison: Undecidability is claimed on rational homogeneous fields of fixed dimension and odd degree, an effectively encoded subclass. The local target includes Lyapunov stability and forward-complete attraction. Homogeneous scaling phi(t,lambda x)=lambda phi(lambda^(d-1)t,x) makes local asymptotic stability equivalent to GAS by scaling every initial point into the attracting neighbourhood, including completeness. A total local decider would decide this undecidable subclass. Lyapunov stability alone is not substituted for asymptotic stability.
